name: Bombardier CRJ700
sources: [700] Bombardier, CRJ700 Airport Planning Manual, CSP B-020, Revision 15 (Dec 17/2015), https://customer.aero.bombardier.com/webd/BAG/CustSite/BRAD/RACSDocument.nsf/51aae8b2b3bfdf6685256c300045ff31/ec63f8639ff3ab9d85257c1500635bd8/$FILE/ATTE8Q23.pdf/CRJ700APMR15.pdf. 00-02-02 Table 1 (p.1): total aircraft length 1273.2 in (32.34 m; printed 32.3 m), wing span 915.2 in (23.25 m), tailplane span 336.4 in (8.54 m), fuselage 105.96 in (2.69 m) across and 1168.5 in (29.68 m) long. Figure 1 sheet 1 (p.3, drawing of Apr 29/2015): overall length 1278.8 in (32.48 m), the aft cargo door's forward side 857.1 in (21.77 m) from the nose, span 915.2 in, the winglet's top 127.9 in (3.25 m) above the ground. Sheet 2 (p.4): wing root chord 191.1 in (4.85 m), from its trailing edge to the tail's end 561.2 in (14.25 m). Table 2 (p.1-2): wheelbase 590.9 in (15.01 m), track 162.2 in (4.12 m).

[900] Bombardier, CRJ900 Airport Planning Manual, CSP C-020, Revision 11 (Dec 17/2015), https://customer.aero.bombardier.com/webd/BAG/CustSite/BRAD/RACSDocument.nsf/51aae8b2b3bfdf6685256c300045ff31/ec63f8639ff3ab9d85257c1500635bd8/$FILE/ATTQF1EY.pdf/CRJ900APMR11.pdf. 00-02-02 Table 1 (p.1, p.8): total aircraft length 1426.70 in (36.24 m), fuselage 1318.80 in (33.50 m) long, wing span 915.20 in (23.24 m) on aircraft 15001-15035, 15038-15039 and 15042, 978.34 in (24.85 m) on the others. Figure 1 sheet 1 (p.3, drawing of Apr 29/2015): overall length 1430.8 in (36.34 m), the aft cargo door's forward side 1009.4 in (25.63 m) from the nose, span 915.2 in (23.25 m), the winglet's top 127.9 in (3.25 m) and the wing tip 76.0 in (1.93 m) above the ground. Sheet 2 (p.4): wing root chord 191.1 in, from its trailing edge to the tail's end 621.1 in (15.77 m). Figure 4 (p.10-11, the aircraft with the 24.85 m span): overall length 1426.70 in (36.24 m). Table 2 (p.1-2): wheelbase 681.1 in (17.3 m), track 160.2 in (4.07 m).

Fuselage, ahead of the wing: 90 in (2.29 m) shorter. [900] prints the plug: its forward cargo floor runs from FS453.00 to FS661.00+90 (X-arm 453.00 to 751.00), 298 in (7.57 m) (00-02-05 Figure 3, p.4); the CRJ700's is 208 in (5.28 m) ([700] 00-02-05 Figure 3, p.4). The CRJ900 keeps the CRJ700's fuselage stations and counts 90 in on at station 661, between the forward hold and the wing. Both footprints have the nose gear at FS228.40 and the main gear at FS819.38, and the wheelbase is 590.98 in (15.01 m) against 681.07 in (17.30 m): 90.1 in (00-07-01 Figure 3, p.6, in both). The CRJ700's overwing exit is 51 ft 6 in (15.70 m) from the nose and the CRJ900's aft overwing exit 59 ft (18.00 m): 7 ft 6 in ([700] 00-02-04 Table 1, p.2; [900] p.2-3). The passenger door (its forward side 13 ft 10 in, 4.22 m) and the service door (14 ft 7 in, 4.47 m) are the same distance from the nose on both.

Fuselage, behind the wing: 62 in (1.57 m) shorter. No figure prints this plug; it is the rest. All behind the wing is 152 in (3.86 m) nearer the nose on the CRJ700: the aft cargo door's forward side 71 ft 5 in (21.77 m) against 84 ft 1 in (25.64 m), the aft equipment bay door 80 ft 5 in (24.51 m) against 93 ft 1 in (28.38 m), each 12 ft 8 in (00-02-04 Table 1). 152 in less the 90 in ahead of the wing: 62 in. The aft cargo compartment has the same stations on both (FS959.50, FS992.00, FS1096.08; 00-02-05, [700] Figure 5, p.7, [900] Figure 4, p.6): the length comes out ahead of it, between the wing and the engines. The engines, the fin and the tailplane are on the rear fuselage and move with it.

Overall length: foreM + aftM = -3.86 m (152 in). The two Figure 1 drawings: 32.48 m - 36.34 m = -3.86 m (152.0 in): no rest. The two Table 1 lengths: 32.34 m - 36.24 m = -3.90 m (153.5 in): a rest of 4 cm, which no station shows. The tables give 5.6 in and 4.1 in less than the drawings, on older pages (Dec 18/2014 and Oct 20/2010; the drawings Dec 17/2015). Two prints give 2 in (5 cm) less than 152 in: the fuselage's length (1168.5 in against 1318.8 in: 150.3 in) and the wing root's trailing edge to the tail's end (561.2 in against 621.1 in: 59.9 in). [900] Figure 4 (p.10) has 1004.40 in (25.51 m) where Figure 1 has 1009.4 in. The recipe follows the door stations.

fore: where the forward length comes out, metres aft of the base's nose on the base's mesh: from behind the passenger door (its parts end 5.23 m from the nose) to the wing root's leading edge (15.87 m). Without it the tool works in the whole constant section, from about 3.5 m, and the door comes out 4.48 m from the nose with its frame out of shape (the base: 4.72 m) and the cockpit windows' aft edge 3.76 m (the base: 3.85 m). With it: door 4.73 m, cockpit windows 3.85 m. Behind the wing the tool's own barrel is right: about 20.8 m to 25.7 m, from the wing root's trailing edge to the nacelles.

Result, measured on the mesh: 32.53 m long (the base's mesh is 36.39 m); wing root 13.58 m to 18.44 m and nacelle inlet 22.19 m aft of the nose; wheelbase 15.01 m. Laid over the side view of [700] Figure 1 at 300 dpi, scaled by the overall length: the nose, the door, the wing root, the winglet, the fuselage's end and the tail's end lie on the drawing; the nacelle's inlet is 0.2 m behind the drawing's, as on the base. The base's mesh has its cabin windows in the skin: they come out 22 % narrower ahead of the wing and 32 % narrower behind it, and as many as the CRJ900 has.

Doors: one passenger door on the left, 36 x 70 in, on both ([700] 00-02-02 Figure 4, p.8; [900] Figure 3, p.7), at the base's station: the nose does not change. No stations of its own. The CRJ700 has one overwing exit on each side (20 x 38 in), the CRJ900 two (20 x 43 in); overwing exits are not listed as doors.

Wingtip: no change. The CRJ700's winglet is the one of the first CRJ900s: span 915.2 in (23.25 m) and winglet top 127.9 in above the ground on both Figure 1 drawings; the wing 404.6 in (10.28 m) outside the fuselage, root chord 191.1 in, tip 66.6 in (1.69 m) on both (sheet 2). The later CRJ900 (Figure 4) has a wider, more canted winglet: span 24.85 m, tip 74.40 in. The base's mesh has the first one: its winglet is 1.24 m tall and leans 17 degrees outboard, 11.58 m to 11.95 m from the centre line ([900]: 1.32 m from the wing tip to the winglet's top). The mesh's span is 23.90 m, 0.65 m more than the 23.25 m: that correction belongs in the base.

Nacelles: no change. Two GE CF34-8C5 on both (00-02-01 Table 1, p.1). Detail A of Figure 1 sheet 2 is the same on both: nacelle 153.7 in (3.90 m) long and 61.1 in (1.55 m) across, its sides 59.6 in and 120.7 in (1.51 m and 3.06 m) from the centre line. The mesh's: 3.87 m long, 1.54 m to 3.12 m from the centre line. Figure 1 sheet 1 prints the nacelle's top 164.5 in (4.18 m) above the ground on the CRJ700 and 175.5 in (4.46 m) on the CRJ900; measured on the two front views by the span it is 172 in and 169 in, and the side views draw the nacelle at the same place on the rear fuselage: no difference to model.

Gear: two wheels on each leg, main tyres H36 x 12.0-18 and nose tyres H20.5 x 6.75-10 on both (00-02-02 Table 2); main wheels 24.52 in (0.62 m) apart, 196.7 in (4.99 m) over the outer tyres, nose wheels 12.2 in (0.31 m) apart on both (00-07-01 Figure 3, p.6). The track is printed 162.2 in (4.12 m) on the CRJ700 and 160.2 in (4.07 m) on the CRJ900; 196.7 in less 24.52 in and a 12-in tyre is 160.2 in, so the two are taken as one gear. Only the wheelbase differs: 15.01 m = 17.30 m - 2.29 m. The base's gear is kept.
